title: Salesforce Agentforce leaks CRM data via injected Web-to-Lead submission (ForcedLeak)
summary: Instructions placed in a Web-to-Lead form field were later executed when an employee asked Agentforce about the lead, causing CRM data to be sent to an attacker through a request to a domain that remained on the content security allowlist after its registration had lapsed. Salesforce began enforcing Trusted URLs for agent output on 8 September 2025.

fixedBy.note: Trusted URLs enforcement for Agentforce and Einstein AI

fixedBy.mitigation: Audit the Trusted URLs allowlist for lapsed or unowned domains
